WorkspaceBearer.description: Use the opaque token returned by POST /api/auth/register, /login or /demo. Sessions expire after 24 hours; logout revokes the current token. All protected reads and writes use its workspace.

info.description: Independent customer-feedback workspace API. First register, sign in or open a demo; use its returned token in Authorize (WorkspaceBearer). Protected reads and writes are scoped to that workspace. Immutable input and versioned results are processed by a separate durable worker. No worker/provider credentials are exposed by this API.
info.title: Feedback Desk API

get.description: Includes one item per automatic or individual analysis job, and one per bulk backfill (without duplicate child-job items). Each job shows only its exact stored output revision. A new view orders IDs by current scheduling availability and an ID tie-breaker; this is not a creation timestamp. Membership and order freeze for ten minutes; status/results can refresh through refresh_cursor. Signed workspace-scoped cursors page persisted positions with SQL LIMIT. At most twenty views are retained per workspace, shared with feedback/backfill views. Each read window contains at most the latest 6000 IDs; has_older reports older stored activity without blocking new work or deleting history. This flag stays fixed throughout the view. Omit cursor to include new work. This endpoint never enqueues work or calls a provider.

get.description: Pages the persisted fixed selection in descending source sequence with SQL keyset pagination. Membership never expands with new arrivals. Each item shows its original non-analysis target-configuration job and only that job's output; later individual analyses are excluded. A selection may reuse an already completed target version. Progress and job states may refresh. Missing and foreign-workspace batches both return 404. Signed cursors are bound to this workspace and batch for ten minutes, sharing the twenty-view workspace limit with feedback views. Reading does not enqueue work or call a provider.

post.description: Accepts user-authored text and an allowed channel. Retain a unique identity for this submission across network retries: identical identity/text/channel returns the existing record with 200; changed content under that identity returns 409. A new immutable input and its durable job commit together and return 201. The separate worker processes it using the configured provider; the request does not wait for enrichment. Existing per-workspace and global limits apply.

post.description: Creates a new durable analysis run using the configured real provider. Previous results remain visible while it runs. Retain identity for network retries: a replay returns 200 without another run; a new request returns 202. One active run per feedback; concurrent requests return 409. There is no lifetime run limit. Record responses include the latest ten jobs and successful outputs. Missing or foreign records return 404. Real-provider mode and calls must be enabled, otherwise 503. Provider budgets, timeouts, output validation and three-attempt limit still apply; acceptance does not guarantee provider availability or successful completion.
